efficiency.format.months: Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec
efficiency.monitorMath.avgCtxHint: How much context one model call re-reads on average.
efficiency.monitorMath.firstCtxP50Hint: Median context size on the first call of a session: what one "empty" start costs.
efficiency.monitorMath.carryShareHint: Share of model input taken by re-read tool output (H26).
efficiency.monitorMath.toolErrorRateHint: Share of tool calls that broke. Guard refusals, Claude Code blocks and failing tests are not counted here; they have their own rows below.
efficiency.monitorMath.guardStopRateHint: Share of calls stopped by a harness hook or by Claude Code itself: a commit without a task key, killing processes by pattern, psql in production without limits, sleep before a command.
efficiency.monitorMath.redGateRateHint: Share of calls where tests, lint or the build genuinely failed on an edit. It grows when the agent sees the real exit code.
efficiency.monitorMath.subagentSonnetSha: Share of subagent calls made on Sonnet.
efficiency.monitorMath.gateVisibleShareH: Share of test, lint and build runs where the agent sees their exit code rather than the pipe's (H29).
efficiency.monitorMath.humanReplyP90MinH: How many minutes it takes a person to reply to the agent in 9 cases out of 10.
efficiency.monitorMath.ciPollsPerMrHint: How many times the agent checks CI status per merge request.
efficiency.monitorMath.costUsdHint: Tokens at public API prices: a measure of load, not a bill.
efficiency.gate.pendingText: The efficiency collector has not finished its first pass over the transcripts yet. This screen fills in by itself once the numbers arrive.
efficiency.monitor.deltaTitle: Last 7 days against the first 14 days of the period
efficiency.monitor.hoverHint: Hover the chart to see the day's values. Click a mark to see what changed and what moved over 7 days.
efficiency.pulseCard.speedText: How fast work with the agents went
efficiency.pulseCard.qualityText: How far you could trust the result
efficiency.pulseCard.frictionText: How much friction there was with the harness
efficiency.pulseCard.saved: Pulse for the week of {week} saved: speed {speed}, trust {quality}, friction {friction}.
efficiency.pulseCard.title: How the week went
efficiency.pulseCard.sub: Three scores from 1 to 5 for the week of {week}. Only you see them; the team's overall feeling is compared with the numbers, without names (H19).
efficiency.efficiencyView.title: Efficiency
efficiency.efficiencyView.sub: How the agent harness is doing, what to fix and what the changes moved · days in Moscow time · personal numbers are visible only to their owner
efficiency.summaryTab.noTrend: nothing to compare with a week ago
efficiency.summaryTab.lead: Over {days}: {cost} at API prices, {sessions}, {mrs}: {perMr} per MR.
efficiency.summaryTab.readingShare: Reading code eats the most context: {share} of everything re-read.
efficiency.summaryTab.allMetricsOk: All metrics with a target are on target
efficiency.summaryTab.periodNote: last 7 days against the previous 7 · updated {at}
efficiency.summaryTab.fixesSub: First what costs money and context, then reliability, then process. Each problem comes with evidence and one step.
efficiency.summaryTab.stateSub: Eight numbers that show whether the harness works well. A title opens its detailed screen.
efficiency.summaryTab.changesSub: The week before a change against the week after. Under three working days after: too early to tell; a difference under 10% is noise.
efficiency.summaryTab.changesEmpty: No harness changes in this period
efficiency.skillsTab.hiddenHint: the skills have no description in the listing, so the model does not know when to call them
efficiency.skillsTab.goneHint: sessions have not seen it in recent days
efficiency.skillsTab.empty: No skill listings for this period: the scanner has not gone through the history yet
efficiency.skillsTab.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the list by hand
efficiency.skillsTab.lead: Over 30 days the agent saw {listed} in the listing and loaded {loaded} ({share}). {never} were never loaded; their lines take about {tokens} tokens at the start of every session.
efficiency.skillsTab.leadNote: Human sessions (Remote Control and tabs), {sessions} in the period. A load is the agent calling a skill; a skill that only sits in the listing does no work but takes up context.
efficiency.skillsTab.offSub: They still arrive in sessions, but none of their skills loaded in 30 days. Together they take about {tokens} tokens in the listing of every session. Switch them off in ~/.claude/settings.json, enabledPlugins; a plugin may also bring hooks or MCP, so check those are not needed. Team hl-* plugins are not listed here: they hold hooks.
efficiency.skillsTab.offNone: No unused plugins still arrive in sessions.
efficiency.skillsTab.goneNote: Already switched off: {count}. Sessions of the last {days} days do not see them.
efficiency.skillsTab.snapshotNote: Based on sessions up to {day}: anything switched off later leaves the list with the first new session.
efficiency.skillsTab.allSub: A row expands the plugin's skills: where shown, how many times loaded and when last. Tokens: how much the plugin's lines take in the listing of one session.
efficiency.changesTab.alertTitle: For you: a regression in the smoke run.
efficiency.changesTab.dayPaneIntro: Median of 7 days before against 7 days after. The colour follows the metric's meaning: green is better, red is worse, grey is a shift smaller than the spread of the first two weeks.
efficiency.changesTab.nearbyNone: Nothing: the shift is easier to attribute to this change.
efficiency.changesTab.notExperiment: A natural change is not an experiment: only an A/B or golden run confirms the cause.
efficiency.changesTab.monitorHint: All metrics on one time axis. The grey band is the spread of the first 14 days of the period (before the changes); the dashed line is a target or a threshold.
efficiency.changesTab.feedSub: Every change and what moved in the 7 days after it. The assessment is automatic: a natural change is not an experiment, so the card shows what else changed nearby.
efficiency.changesTab.feedEmpty: Nothing changed in the harness in this period.
efficiency.hypothesesTab.legend: On the board the tick is September, the green zone is the target, the dot is now. Until there is a measurement there is no dot: an empty value is not drawn as zero.
efficiency.hypothesesTab.title: Hypotheses
efficiency.hypothesesTab.sub: A board like in CI: where we were in September, where the target is and what we see now. A row opens the metric and a link to the experiment.
efficiency.sessionsTab.tooFewCalls: too few calls for a cardiogram
efficiency.sessionsTab.cardioLabel: Context over the session: peak {peak}, above 250K: {share} of re-read
efficiency.sessionsTab.attentionSub: {from} to {to}. Only your numbers: nobody else sees them, and there is no ranking of people.
efficiency.sessionsTab.replyHint: Time from the end of the agent's reply to your message.
efficiency.sessionsTab.autonomyHint: How long the agent worked without needing you, in 9 cases out of 10.
efficiency.sessionsTab.waitHint: How long the agent sat idle waiting for an answer to its question.
efficiency.sessionsTab.parallelHint: How many sessions you had in progress at the same time.
efficiency.sessionsTab.sessionsSub: The cardiogram shows how much context each call re-reads over the session. Red is above the 250K line: handing the work to a fresh session would have saved that part. Only the owner sees this list.
efficiency.sessionsTab.empty: You have no sessions in this period
efficiency.componentsTab.title: Components
efficiency.componentsTab.sub: Skills, MCP, CLI and hooks by family, {from} to {to}. A row opens a page: calls by day, actions, composition and experiments.
efficiency.componentsTab.empty: No components were called in this period
efficiency.componentsTab.carryNote: Re-read: tokens of tool output and skill bodies, multiplied by the number of model calls that re-read them before context compaction. Total across all families: {total}.
efficiency.componentsTab.colFollowups: What the agent did in the 30 calls after loading
efficiency.componentsTab.carryHint: Tokens of tool output and skill bodies, multiplied by the number of model calls that re-read them.
efficiency.componentsTab.compositionSub: Subcomponents of the family: what exactly was called, what it cost in context and how often it failed.
efficiency.componentsTab.skillsSub: After a skill loads, the agent acts on its body: you can see which calls it turns into and whether errors grow after it.
efficiency.runsTab.smokeChartLabel: Smoke: tasks out of {total} per run, with the A/A noise band and marks where the harness fingerprint changed
efficiency.runsTab.budget: Budget is a share of the weekly subscription window: cap {cap}%, spent {used}%.
efficiency.runsTab.budgetWithWindow: Budget is a share of the weekly subscription window: cap {cap}%, spent {used}%, window {window}% used.

efficiency.runsTab.scheduleTotals.one: Enabled suites: {count} run per week, {share}% of the week.
efficiency.runsTab.scheduleTotals.other: Enabled suites: {count} runs per week, {share}% of the week.

efficiency.runsTab.alertMineSub: Highlighted for you because the harness change is yours. Others see the alert in this list without the highlight; it is not sent to Telegram.
efficiency.runsTab.alertAddresseeSub: The alert's addressee will see it highlighted.
efficiency.runsTab.summaryOnly: This run has only a summary.
efficiency.runsTab.dangerSub: Dangerous scenarios from appendix V on a personal harness, 3 runs each; a scenario holds if it is stopped in all three.
efficiency.runsTab.dangerTwelfth: The twelfth, a swapped MCP tool description, is invisible to hooks and is not run.
efficiency.runsTab.armsSub: The same 8 tasks, 3 runs each; each arm is compared with its own base only on tasks both passed. pass³ is the share of tasks passed in all three.
efficiency.runsTab.armsEmpty: The arms have not been run yet
efficiency.runsTab.manualSub: One batch of the selected suite now, outside the schedule. Spends the weekly budget.
efficiency.runsTab.manualSubDisabled: The runner is off: until the owner turns it on, the batch only joins the queue.
efficiency.runsTab.runnerOff: The runner is off; the owner turns it on. The schedule below is a plan: nothing runs until the runner is on.
efficiency.runsTab.smokeHint: How many tasks of the suite passed checks by exit code. The A/A band is the spread of the same harness run twice.
efficiency.runsTab.fingerprintHint: A short hash of the harness composition: if it changed between runs, something was changed.
efficiency.runsTab.smokeSub: How many tasks passed checks. The grey band is the A/A spread. Yellow squares mark a harness fingerprint change between runs; a red dot is outside the band.
efficiency.runsTab.batchesSub: A row opens the tasks and checks with exit codes. Run transcripts are marked origin = eval and do not count in live metrics.
efficiency.runsTab.compareSub: Two harness compositions on the same tasks: which costs more, which passes more often.
